svg.text: INF2006 Airbnb Pricing and Market Intelligence Platform
Terraform-defined architecture and trust flows | AWS ap-southeast-1 | Serverless, two-AZ private Lambda networking, Zero Trust controls
Region: ap-southeast-1 except global CloudFront and WAF
CORS allowlist, request throttling, JWT authorizer
Public: health, predict, analytics | Protected: predictions, history, chat
Zero Trust decision point: authenticate protected routes, then authorize per request.
No public subnets, internet gateway, or NAT Gateway
Lambda functions configured for both subnets
AWS selects healthy subnet capacity; functions are not pinned to one AZ
Separate least-privilege IAM role per function | Lambda security group allows outbound TCP 443
Offline data engineering and analytics flow
Current deployment uses reviewed local Terraform; the repository CD path requires an AWS OIDC role before use

1 Edge request | 2 WAF to CloudFront | 3 Private S3 origin | 4 Cognito sign-in | 5 API authorization | 6 Lambda invocation | 7 Private AWS endpoints | 8 Data, AI, and logs | 9 Alerts and audit | 10 Offline analytics pipeline | 11 CI/CD and IaC
